[[Cisleithania|Austria]] competed at the [[1904 Summer Olympics]] in [[St. Louis, Missouri|St. Louis]], [[United States]]. Austrian and Hungarian results at early Olympic Games are generally kept separate despite the union of the two nations as [[Austria-Hungary]] at the time.

Austrian gymnast [[Julius Lenhart]], who from 1903 to 1906 worked in America and in 1904 represented the sports club ''Philadelphia Turngemeinde'' mainly attended by German speaking gymnasts, won two gold medals and one silver medal,<ref>[https://olympics.com/en/athletes/julius-lenhart information about ''Julius Lenhart'' in olympics.com]</ref> making him the most successful Austrian competitor ever at the Summer Olympic Games.<ref>{{cite web |title=St. Louis 1904 Gymnastics Artistic individual all-round men Results |url=https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/st-louis-1904/results/gymnastics-artistic/individual-all-round-men |website=Olympic Channel |access-date=6 July 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=St. Louis 1904 Gymnastics Artistic combined 3 events men Results |url=https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/st-louis-1904/results/gymnastics-artistic/combined-3-events-men |website=Olympic Channel |access-date=6 July 2021 |language=en}}</ref>
